decisions.reason: Define-XML ADADAS.CHG (MT.ADADAS.CHG, lines 4448-4451) and workbook Methods!D10 state AVAL - BASE without baseline suppression, which adadas-probe.yaml lines 184-187 executes from the independent reference AVAL and BASE. The reported missing-reference/zero-literal pattern follows from this formula; ADRG pages 45-48 explain imputation changes without replacing the subtraction rule.

ADRG page 47 explicitly shows the current R-generated Week 16 imputed record carrying the Week 8 donor visit and date, so the page-11 date-window description cannot be applied to the carried donor date as a universal rule for imputed visits. The planned-visit branch is consistent with that retained example; its complete assignment algorithm remains unspecified.

Define-XML ADADAS.AVISITN defines numeric mappings for all enumerated AVISIT values, while adadas.yaml AVISITN implements only Baseline, Week 8, Week 16 and Week 24. The retained sources provide no ADADAS-specific restriction that removes the other documented mapping pairs.

Define-XML ADADAS.ADY states the date-relative arithmetic, and adadas.yaml ADY_RAW computes it using TRTSDT. ADT and ADY then carry the same ANL01FL-selected donor under identical subject/parameter grouping and visit ordering, so carrying the calculated day preserves the formula for final ADT rather than expressing different arithmetic.

Define-XML ADADAS.BASE states QS.QSBLFL=Y with QS.VISITNUM=3, while adadas.yaml BASE filters only the copied baseline flag. No VISITNUM=3 selection appears anywhere in the specification; the native SDTM QSBLFL comment at define-sdtm.xml line 3858 names the BASELINE visit but does not add that specification condition.

Define-XML ADADAS.PCHG states 100* (CHG/BASE), whereas adadas.yaml PCHG explicitly applies NULLIF(BASE, 0) before division. Expanding CHG is algebraically consistent on eligible rows, but the extra zero-baseline output handling is not stated in that method or the retained ADRG.

Define-XML ADADAS.DTYPE assigns LOCF to imputed ACTOT records, and the specification explicitly defines its planned template as one row per missing ACTOT visit slot at adadas.yaml lines 11-12. Using ROWSRC=1 for that template expresses the documented predicate; ADRG pages 45-47 distinguish these current imputed records from incorrectly labeled original CDISC records and show no conflicting current assignment.
